channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLhealthAndWellness, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Kenya Ebola cases reach eight, no community spread reported
item.description: Kenya's Ebola cases rose to eight on Sunday after another person in quarantine tested positive, identified as a contact of the first case.

item.title: Shorter breast RT found noninferior for reconstruction complications
item.description: A shorter radiotherapy schedule was noninferior to standard-length treatment for reconstruction complications, with no significant differences in locoregional recurrence.

item.title: Rapid whole-genome sequencing resolves nearly half of pediatric neuro cases
item.description: Rapid genome sequencing has proven effective in the ICU. Data from the first known study in neuro-specific pediatric inpatients suggest it may be equally useful.

item.title: Weight shame may increase food noise after bariatric surgery
item.description: Adults who feel more ashamed of their weight report more food noise about a year after bariatric surgery, even when their weight is stable.
